class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

async def _seed_position(conn, *, action="buy", qty, price, ticker="TSLA", strike=250.0):
    sig = _signal(action, 1, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=ostore.FILLED, filled_qty=qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price)


async def _seed_standing_buy(conn, *, msg_id, requested_qty, filled_qty=0,
                             status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=1.5, ticker="TSLA",
                             strike=250.0):
    """A working entry BUY left non-FILLED (PENDING/SUBMITTED/PARTIAL) so it shows up in
    standing_buy_orders. A PARTIAL with filled_qty>0 also contributes to open_positions.
    Returns the order_id (so a test can assert the expected order_ref)."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(requested_qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status, filled_qty=filled_qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price if filled_qty else None)
    return oid


async def _seed_leg(conn, *, signal_type, qty, ticker="NVDA", strike=900.0,
                    status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=6.0, msg_id=1):
    """A resting protective SELL leg (stop_loss / take_profit) on a contract."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ, requested_qty=int(qty),
                                    limit_price=price, signal_type=signal_type, side="SELL")
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status)
    return oid

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

def _signal(action, msg_id, *, ticker="AAPL", strike=420.0, option_type="call",
            expiry=date(2026, 6, 20), premium=1.5, scale="neutral"):

def _exit_signal(action, msg_id, ticker, *, strike=None, expiry=None,
                 option_type=None, scale="neutral"):

def _interp(trade=None, *, confidence=0.9, reasoning="", error=None):
    return types.SimpleNamespace(

    )


def _fixed_interpret(result):
    async def _fn(**kwargs):
        return result
    return _fn

async def _seed_position(conn, *, action="buy", qty, price, ticker="TSLA", strike=250.0):
    sig = _signal(action, 1, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=ostore.FILLED, filled_qty=qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price)


async def _seed_standing_buy(conn, *, msg_id, requested_qty, filled_qty=0,
                             status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=1.5, ticker="TSLA",
                             strike=250.0):
    """A working entry BUY left non-FILLED (PENDING/SUBMITTED/PARTIAL) so it shows up in
    standing_buy_orders. A PARTIAL with filled_qty>0 also contributes to open_positions.
    Returns the order_id (so a test can assert the expected order_ref)."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(requested_qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status, filled_qty=filled_qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price if filled_qty else None)
    return oid


async def _seed_leg(conn, *, signal_type, qty, ticker="NVDA", strike=900.0,
                    status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=6.0, msg_id=1):
    """A resting protective SELL leg (stop_loss / take_profit) on a contract."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ, requested_qty=int(qty),
                                    limit_price=price, signal_type=signal_type, side="SELL")
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status)
    return oid

class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash

        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

    def account_snapshot(self):

    async def qualify(self, option):

            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

    return Signal("KENNY", "kenny", trade, msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny",
                  f"[{action}] ...", 0.0)


def _exit_signal(action, msg_id, ticker, *, strike=None, expiry=None,
                 option_type=None, scale="neutral"):
    """A SELL/TRIM that may be ambiguous (only ticker) or specified."""
    trade = ParsedTrade(action, ticker, expiry, strike, option_type, None, scale)
    return Signal("KENNY", "llm", trade, msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny",
                  f"[{action}] {ticker}", 0.0)


def _inbound(msg_id, content="some alert"):
    return InboundMessage("KENNY", msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny", content, 0.0)


def _interp(trade=None, *, confidence=0.9, reasoning="", error=None):
    return types.SimpleNamespace(
        trade=trade, confidence=confidence, reasoning=reasoning, error=error,
    )


def _fixed_interpret(result):
    async def _fn(**kwargs):
        return result
    return _fn


async def _conn():
    c = await db.connect(":memory:")
    await db.init_db(c)
    return c


async def _seed_position(conn, *, action="buy", qty, price, ticker="TSLA", strike=250.0):
    sig = _signal(action, 1, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=ostore.FILLED, filled_qty=qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price)


async def _seed_standing_buy(conn, *, msg_id, requested_qty, filled_qty=0,
                             status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=1.5, ticker="TSLA",
                             strike=250.0):
    """A working entry BUY left non-FILLED (PENDING/SUBMITTED/PARTIAL) so it shows up in
    standing_buy_orders. A PARTIAL with filled_qty>0 also contributes to open_positions.
    Returns the order_id (so a test can assert the expected order_ref)."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(requested_qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status, filled_qty=filled_qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price if filled_qty else None)
    return oid


async def _seed_leg(conn, *, signal_type, qty, ticker="NVDA", strike=900.0,
                    status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=6.0, msg_id=1):
    """A resting protective SELL leg (stop_loss / take_profit) on a contract."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ, requested_qty=int(qty),
                                    limit_price=price, signal_type=signal_type, side="SELL")
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status)
    return oid

class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

        if not self.qualify_ok:

        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

def _update(ref, status, *, filled=0.0, avg=None):
    from only_trades.brokers.protocol import OrderUpdate
    return OrderUpdate(order_ref=ref, status=status, filled_qty=filled, avg_fill_price=avg)


def _config_sltp(stop=0.5, target=1.0):
    from only_trades.config import LLMConfig
    return Config(
        discord_token="", notify_channel_id=None, profile="dev",
        dashboard_host="", dashboard_port=0, dashboard_token=None,
        traders={"KENNY": Trader("KENNY", 111, 0.45, 3)},
        policy=OrderPolicy(stop_loss_pct=stop, take_profit_pct=target),
        llm=LLMConfig(), active_trader_ids=["KENNY"],
    )


async def test_buy_with_policy_records_three_rows_with_protective_prices():
    conn = await _conn()
    ib, notes = FakeIB(), FakeNotifier()
    ex = Executor(conn, _config_sltp(stop=0.5, target=1.0), ib, notes)

    await ex.process_signal(_signal("buy", 950, premium=2.0))

    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}
    assert set(rows) == {"buy", "take_profit", "stop_loss"}
    assert rows["buy"]["side"] == "BUY"
    # protective legs are SELLs, PENDING until they trigger
    assert rows["take_profit"]["side"] == "SELL" and rows["take_profit"]["status"] == ostore.PENDING
    assert rows["stop_loss"]["side"] == "SELL" and rows["stop_loss"]["status"] == ostore.PENDING
    assert rows["take_profit"]["limit_price"] == 4.0   # 2.0 * (1 + 1.0)
    assert rows["stop_loss"]["limit_price"] == 1.0     # 2.0 * (1 - 0.5)
    # the broker received a protective_exit carrying both child refs
    pe = ib.placed[0]["protective_exit"]
    assert pe is not None and pe.stop_price == 1.0 and pe.take_profit_price == 4.0
    assert pe.stop_ref == f"KENNY:{rows['stop_loss']['order_id']}"
    assert pe.take_profit_ref == f"KENNY:{rows['take_profit']['order_id']}"

async def test_take_profit_fill_closes_position_and_cancels_stop():
    conn = await _conn()
    ib, notes = FakeIB(), FakeNotifier()
    ex = Executor(conn, _config_sltp(stop=0.5, target=1.0), ib, notes)
    ib.register_order_update(ex.on_order_update)  # wired exactly as main.py does
    await ex.process_signal(_signal("buy", 952, premium=2.0))  # entry fills 100 (0.15*100k/200)

    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}
    entry_qty = rows["buy"]["filled_qty"]
    assert entry_qty > 0

    tp_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['take_profit']['order_id']}"
    sl_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['stop_loss']['order_id']}"

    # Broker reports the take-profit leg filled, then (OCA) the stop cancelled.
    await ib.on_update(_update(tp_ref, ostore.FILLED, filled=entry_qty, avg=4.0))
    await ib.on_update(_update(sl_ref, ostore.CANCELLED))

    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}
    assert rows["take_profit"]["status"] == ostore.FILLED
    assert rows["take_profit"]["filled_qty"] == entry_qty
    assert rows["stop_loss"]["status"] == ostore.CANCELLED
    # net position is flat (BUY filled - SELL filled == 0)
    assert await ostore.open_positions(conn, "KENNY") == []

    # The take-profit fill is notified and tagged to the entry order it protects.
    tp_updates = [(r, u) for r, u in notes.order_updates if r["signal_type"] == "take_profit"]
    assert tp_updates, "expected a take-profit order-update notification"
    r, u = tp_updates[-1]
    assert u.status == ostore.FILLED
    assert r.get("parent_order_id") == rows["buy"]["order_id"]

    assert rows["buy"]["status"] == ostore.REJECTED
    assert rows["stop_loss"]["status"] == ostore.CANCELLED
    assert rows["take_profit"]["status"] == ostore.CANCELLED
    assert set(ib.cancels) == {
        f"KENNY:{rows['stop_loss']['order_id']}",
        f"KENNY:{rows['take_profit']['order_id']}",
    }


async def test_entry_cancelled_before_fill_settles_protective_legs():
    conn = await _conn()
    ib, notes = FakeIB(status=ostore.SUBMITTED), FakeNotifier()
    ex = Executor(conn, _config_sltp(stop=0.5, target=1.0), ib, notes)
    await ex.process_signal(_signal("buy", 971, premium=2.0))   # entry rests, legs PENDING
    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}
    assert rows["stop_loss"]["status"] == ostore.PENDING        # not settled while entry works

    await ex.on_order_update(_update(f"KENNY:{rows['buy']['order_id']}", ostore.CANCELLED))
    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}
    assert rows["stop_loss"]["status"] == ostore.CANCELLED
    assert rows["take_profit"]["status"] == ostore.CANCELLED
    assert set(ib.cancels) == {
        f"KENNY:{rows['stop_loss']['order_id']}",
        f"KENNY:{rows['take_profit']['order_id']}",
    }


async def test_partially_filled_entry_cancel_resizes_protective_legs():
    conn = await _conn()
    ib, notes = FakeIB(status=ostore.SUBMITTED), FakeNotifier()
    ex = Executor(conn, _config_sltp(stop=0.5, target=1.0), ib, notes)
    await ex.process_signal(_signal("buy", 972, premium=2.0))
    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}
    entry_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['buy']['order_id']}"
    sl_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['stop_loss']['order_id']}"
    tp_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['take_profit']['order_id']}"
    assert rows["buy"]["requested_qty"] > 5  # sanity: 5 is a genuine partial

    # A partial fill (5) then a timeout cancel of the remainder leaves a real 5-lot
    # position; the legs must be RESIZED down to 5, not cancelled.
    await ex.on_order_update(_update(entry_ref, ostore.PARTIAL, filled=5, avg=2.0))
    await ex.on_order_update(_update(entry_ref, ostore.CANCELLED, filled=5))
    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}
    assert rows["stop_loss"]["status"] == ostore.PENDING       # still working
    assert rows["take_profit"]["status"] == ostore.PENDING
    assert rows["stop_loss"]["requested_qty"] == 5             # trimmed to the fill
    assert rows["take_profit"]["requested_qty"] == 5
    assert ib.cancels == []                                     # legs kept, not cancelled
    assert set(ib.modifies) == {(sl_ref, 5), (tp_ref, 5)}      # broker legs resized

# ---- fakes ---------------------------------------------------------------
class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))


def _config(llm=None, policy=None):
    from only_trades.config import LLMConfig
    return Config(
        discord_token="", notify_channel_id=None, profile="dev",
        dashboard_host="", dashboard_port=0, dashboard_token=None,
        traders={"KENNY": Trader("KENNY", 111, 0.45, 3)},
        policy=policy or OrderPolicy(), llm=llm or LLMConfig(),
        active_trader_ids=["KENNY"],
    )


def _signal(action, msg_id, *, ticker="AAPL", strike=420.0, option_type="call",
            expiry=date(2026, 6, 20), premium=1.5, scale="neutral"):
    trade = ParsedTrade(action, ticker, expiry, strike, option_type, premium, scale)
    return Signal("KENNY", "kenny", trade, msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny",
                  f"[{action}] ...", 0.0)


def _exit_signal(action, msg_id, ticker, *, strike=None, expiry=None,
                 option_type=None, scale="neutral"):
    """A SELL/TRIM that may be ambiguous (only ticker) or specified."""
    trade = ParsedTrade(action, ticker, expiry, strike, option_type, None, scale)
    return Signal("KENNY", "llm", trade, msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny",
                  f"[{action}] {ticker}", 0.0)


def _inbound(msg_id, content="some alert"):
    return InboundMessage("KENNY", msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny", content, 0.0)


def _interp(trade=None, *, confidence=0.9, reasoning="", error=None):
    return types.SimpleNamespace(
        trade=trade, confidence=confidence, reasoning=reasoning, error=error,
    )


def _fixed_interpret(result):
    async def _fn(**kwargs):
        return result
    return _fn


async def _conn():
    c = await db.connect(":memory:")
    await db.init_db(c)
    return c


async def _seed_position(conn, *, action="buy", qty, price, ticker="TSLA", strike=250.0):
    sig = _signal(action, 1, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=ostore.FILLED, filled_qty=qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price)


async def _seed_standing_buy(conn, *, msg_id, requested_qty, filled_qty=0,
                             status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=1.5, ticker="TSLA",
                             strike=250.0):
    """A working entry BUY left non-FILLED (PENDING/SUBMITTED/PARTIAL) so it shows up in
    standing_buy_orders. A PARTIAL with filled_qty>0 also contributes to open_positions.
    Returns the order_id (so a test can assert the expected order_ref)."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(requested_qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status, filled_qty=filled_qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price if filled_qty else None)
    return oid


async def _seed_leg(conn, *, signal_type, qty, ticker="NVDA", strike=900.0,
                    status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=6.0, msg_id=1):
    """A resting protective SELL leg (stop_loss / take_profit) on a contract."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ, requested_qty=int(qty),
                                    limit_price=price, signal_type=signal_type, side="SELL")
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status)
    return oid

    conn = await _conn()
    ib, notes = FakeIB(), FakeNotifier()
    ex = Executor(conn, _config_sltp(stop=0.5, target=1.0), ib, notes)
    ib.register_order_update(ex.on_order_update)  # wired exactly as main.py does
    await ex.process_signal(_signal("buy", 952, premium=2.0))  # entry fills 100 (0.15*100k/200)

    assert entry_qty > 0

    tp_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['take_profit']['order_id']}"
    sl_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['stop_loss']['order_id']}"

    # Broker reports the take-profit leg filled, then (OCA) the stop cancelled.
    await ib.on_update(_update(tp_ref, ostore.FILLED, filled=entry_qty, avg=4.0))
    await ib.on_update(_update(sl_ref, ostore.CANCELLED))

    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}

    assert rows["take_profit"]["filled_qty"] == entry_qty
    assert rows["stop_loss"]["status"] == ostore.CANCELLED
    # net position is flat (BUY filled - SELL filled == 0)
    assert await ostore.open_positions(conn, "KENNY") == []

    # The take-profit fill is notified and tagged to the entry order it protects.
    tp_updates = [(r, u) for r, u in notes.order_updates if r["signal_type"] == "take_profit"]
    assert tp_updates, "expected a take-profit order-update notification"
    r, u = tp_updates[-1]

    assert r.get("parent_order_id") == rows["buy"]["order_id"]

from dataclasses import replace as dc_replace
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone

from only_trades import db
from only_trades import orders as ostore
from only_trades.config import Config, OrderPolicy, Trader
from only_trades.executor import Executor
from only_trades.ib_client import AccountSnapshot, PlaceResult
from only_trades.options import occ_symbol
from only_trades.signals import InboundMessage, ParsedTrade, Signal


# ---- fakes ---------------------------------------------------------------
class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))


def _config(llm=None, policy=None):
    from only_trades.config import LLMConfig
    return Config(
        discord_token="", notify_channel_id=None, profile="dev",
        dashboard_host="", dashboard_port=0, dashboard_token=None,
        traders={"KENNY": Trader("KENNY", 111, 0.45, 3)},
        policy=policy or OrderPolicy(), llm=llm or LLMConfig(),
        active_trader_ids=["KENNY"],
    )


def _signal(action, msg_id, *, ticker="AAPL", strike=420.0, option_type="call",
            expiry=date(2026, 6, 20), premium=1.5, scale="neutral"):
    trade = ParsedTrade(action, ticker, expiry, strike, option_type, premium, scale)
    return Signal("KENNY", "kenny", trade, msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny",
                  f"[{action}] ...", 0.0)


def _exit_signal(action, msg_id, ticker, *, strike=None, expiry=None,
                 option_type=None, scale="neutral"):
    """A SELL/TRIM that may be ambiguous (only ticker) or specified."""
    trade = ParsedTrade(action, ticker, expiry, strike, option_type, None, scale)
    return Signal("KENNY", "llm", trade, msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny",
                  f"[{action}] {ticker}", 0.0)


def _inbound(msg_id, content="some alert"):
    return InboundMessage("KENNY", msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny", content, 0.0)


def _interp(trade=None, *, confidence=0.9, reasoning="", error=None):
    return types.SimpleNamespace(
        trade=trade, confidence=confidence, reasoning=reasoning, error=error,
    )


def _fixed_interpret(result):
    async def _fn(**kwargs):
        return result
    return _fn


async def _conn():
    c = await db.connect(":memory:")
    await db.init_db(c)
    return c


async def _seed_position(conn, *, action="buy", qty, price, ticker="TSLA", strike=250.0):
    sig = _signal(action, 1, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=ostore.FILLED, filled_qty=qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price)


async def _seed_standing_buy(conn, *, msg_id, requested_qty, filled_qty=0,
                             status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=1.5, ticker="TSLA",
                             strike=250.0):
    """A working entry BUY left non-FILLED (PENDING/SUBMITTED/PARTIAL) so it shows up in
    standing_buy_orders. A PARTIAL with filled_qty>0 also contributes to open_positions.
    Returns the order_id (so a test can assert the expected order_ref)."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(requested_qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status, filled_qty=filled_qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price if filled_qty else None)
    return oid


async def _seed_leg(conn, *, signal_type, qty, ticker="NVDA", strike=900.0,
                    status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=6.0, msg_id=1):
    """A resting protective SELL leg (stop_loss / take_profit) on a contract."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ, requested_qty=int(qty),
                                    limit_price=price, signal_type=signal_type, side="SELL")
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status)
    return oid

async def test_buy_end_to_end_is_recorded_and_tagged():
    conn = await _conn()
    ib, notes = FakeIB(), FakeNotifier()
    ex = Executor(conn, _config(), ib, notes)

    await ex.process_signal(_signal("buy", 900))

    rows = await ostore.list_orders(conn)
    assert len(rows) == 1
    row = rows[0]
    assert row["status"] == ostore.FILLED
    assert row["trader_id"] == "KENNY" and row["message_id"] == 900
    assert row["side"] == "BUY" and row["filled_qty"] == 100  # 0.15*100k / 150
    # tagged with trader:order_id on the IB order
    assert ib.placed[0]["order_ref"] == f"KENNY:{row['order_id']}"
    assert notes.placed and notes.status


async def test_buy_blocked_when_exposure_cap_reached():
    conn = await _conn()
    # pre-existing 90 contracts @ mark 5 -> 90*5*100 = 45k = full Kenny cap (0.45*100k)
    await _seed_position(conn, qty=90, price=5.0)
    ib, notes = FakeIB(mark_px=5.0), FakeNotifier()
    ex = Executor(conn, _config(), ib, notes)

    await ex.process_signal(_signal("buy", 901))

    assert "skip_no_headroom" in notes.skips
    # no new order placed for message 901
    assert not any(r["message_id"] == 901 for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn))
    assert ib.placed == []


async def test_resting_unfilled_buy_reserves_exposure_headroom():
    conn = await _conn()
    # A resting (SUBMITTED, unfilled) buy of 90 @ limit 5 = 45k = Kenny's full cap.
    await _seed_standing_buy(conn, msg_id=901, requested_qty=90, price=5.0,
                             ticker="TSLA", strike=250.0)
    ib, notes = FakeIB(mark_px=5.0), FakeNotifier()
    ex = Executor(conn, _config(), ib, notes)
    # A *different* contract: cap is consumed by the resting order, so no headroom left.
    await ex.process_signal(_signal("buy", 902, ticker="AAPL", strike=420.0))
    assert "skip_no_headroom" in notes.skips
    assert ib.placed == []


async def test_pending_buys_count_toward_max_open_trades():
    conn = await _conn()
    # Three resting buys in three distinct contracts (tiny notional -> cap isn't binding).
    for i, strike in enumerate((900.0, 950.0, 1000.0)):
        await _seed_standing_buy(conn, msg_id=910 + i, requested_qty=1, price=0.5,
                                 ticker="NVDA", strike=strike)
    ib, notes = FakeIB(), FakeNotifier()
    ex = Executor(conn, _config(), ib, notes)   # KENNY max_open_trades=3
    # A fourth, *new* contract would open a 4th slot -> blocked.
    await ex.process_signal(_signal("buy", 913, ticker="NVDA", strike=850.0))
    assert "max_open_trades" in notes.skips
    assert ib.placed == []


async def test_adding_to_a_contract_with_a_pending_buy_is_allowed():

                                 ticker="NVDA", strike=strike)

    assert "max_open_trades" not in notes.skips

    tp_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['take_profit']['order_id']}"
    sl_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['stop_loss']['order_id']}"

    # Broker reports the take-profit leg filled, then (OCA) the stop cancelled.

    # net position is flat (BUY filled - SELL filled == 0)
    assert await ostore.open_positions(conn, "KENNY") == []

class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

async def _seed_position(conn, *, action="buy", qty, price, ticker="TSLA", strike=250.0):

    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=ostore.FILLED, filled_qty=qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price)


async def _seed_standing_buy(conn, *, msg_id, requested_qty, filled_qty=0,
                             status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=1.5, ticker="TSLA",
                             strike=250.0):
    """A working entry BUY left non-FILLED (PENDING/SUBMITTED/PARTIAL) so it shows up in
    standing_buy_orders. A PARTIAL with filled_qty>0 also contributes to open_positions.
    Returns the order_id (so a test can assert the expected order_ref)."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(requested_qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status, filled_qty=filled_qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price if filled_qty else None)
    return oid


async def _seed_leg(conn, *, signal_type, qty, ticker="NVDA", strike=900.0,
                    status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=6.0, msg_id=1):
    """A resting protective SELL leg (stop_loss / take_profit) on a contract."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ, requested_qty=int(qty),
                                    limit_price=price, signal_type=signal_type, side="SELL")
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status)
    return oid

class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

def _signal(action, msg_id, *, ticker="AAPL", strike=420.0, option_type="call",
            expiry=date(2026, 6, 20), premium=1.5, scale="neutral"):
    trade = ParsedTrade(action, ticker, expiry, strike, option_type, premium, scale)
    return Signal("KENNY", "kenny", trade, msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny",
                  f"[{action}] ...", 0.0)


def _exit_signal(action, msg_id, ticker, *, strike=None, expiry=None,
                 option_type=None, scale="neutral"):
    """A SELL/TRIM that may be ambiguous (only ticker) or specified."""
    trade = ParsedTrade(action, ticker, expiry, strike, option_type, None, scale)
    return Signal("KENNY", "llm", trade, msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny",
                  f"[{action}] {ticker}", 0.0)

    return InboundMessage("KENNY", msg_id, 111, 222, "kenny", content, 0.0)


def _interp(trade=None, *, confidence=0.9, reasoning="", error=None):
    return types.SimpleNamespace(
        trade=trade, confidence=confidence, reasoning=reasoning, error=error,
    )


def _fixed_interpret(result):
    async def _fn(**kwargs):
        return result
    return _fn

async def _seed_position(conn, *, action="buy", qty, price, ticker="TSLA", strike=250.0):
    sig = _signal(action, 1, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=ostore.FILLED, filled_qty=qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price)


async def _seed_standing_buy(conn, *, msg_id, requested_qty, filled_qty=0,
                             status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=1.5, ticker="TSLA",
                             strike=250.0):
    """A working entry BUY left non-FILLED (PENDING/SUBMITTED/PARTIAL) so it shows up in
    standing_buy_orders. A PARTIAL with filled_qty>0 also contributes to open_positions.
    Returns the order_id (so a test can assert the expected order_ref)."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(requested_qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status, filled_qty=filled_qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price if filled_qty else None)
    return oid


async def _seed_leg(conn, *, signal_type, qty, ticker="NVDA", strike=900.0,
                    status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=6.0, msg_id=1):
    """A resting protective SELL leg (stop_loss / take_profit) on a contract."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ, requested_qty=int(qty),
                                    limit_price=price, signal_type=signal_type, side="SELL")
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status)
    return oid

class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

    sig = _signal(action, 1, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=ostore.FILLED, filled_qty=qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price)


async def _seed_standing_buy(conn, *, msg_id, requested_qty, filled_qty=0,
                             status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=1.5, ticker="TSLA",
                             strike=250.0):
    """A working entry BUY left non-FILLED (PENDING/SUBMITTED/PARTIAL) so it shows up in
    standing_buy_orders. A PARTIAL with filled_qty>0 also contributes to open_positions.
    Returns the order_id (so a test can assert the expected order_ref)."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(requested_qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status, filled_qty=filled_qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price if filled_qty else None)
    return oid


async def _seed_leg(conn, *, signal_type, qty, ticker="NVDA", strike=900.0,
                    status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=6.0, msg_id=1):
    """A resting protective SELL leg (stop_loss / take_profit) on a contract."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ, requested_qty=int(qty),
                                    limit_price=price, signal_type=signal_type, side="SELL")
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status)
    return oid

    ib.register_order_update(ex.on_order_update)  # wired exactly as main.py does
    await ex.process_signal(_signal("buy", 952, premium=2.0))  # entry fills 100 (0.15*100k/200)

    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}
    entry_qty = rows["buy"]["filled_qty"]
    assert entry_qty > 0

    tp_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['take_profit']['order_id']}"
    sl_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['stop_loss']['order_id']}"

    # Broker reports the take-profit leg filled, then (OCA) the stop cancelled.
    await ib.on_update(_update(tp_ref, ostore.FILLED, filled=entry_qty, avg=4.0))
    await ib.on_update(_update(sl_ref, ostore.CANCELLED))

    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}
    assert rows["take_profit"]["status"] == ostore.FILLED
    assert rows["take_profit"]["filled_qty"] == entry_qty
    assert rows["stop_loss"]["status"] == ostore.CANCELLED
    # net position is flat (BUY filled - SELL filled == 0)
    assert await ostore.open_positions(conn, "KENNY") == []

    # The take-profit fill is notified and tagged to the entry order it protects.
    tp_updates = [(r, u) for r, u in notes.order_updates if r["signal_type"] == "take_profit"]
    assert tp_updates, "expected a take-profit order-update notification"
    r, u = tp_updates[-1]
    assert u.status == ostore.FILLED
    assert r.get("parent_order_id") == rows["buy"]["order_id"]

class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,

    return oid

class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,

    from only_trades.brokers.protocol import OrderUpdate
    return OrderUpdate(order_ref=ref, status=status, filled_qty=filled, avg_fill_price=avg)

        traders={"KENNY": Trader("KENNY", 111, 0.45, 3)},

        llm=LLMConfig(), active_trader_ids=["KENNY"],

    conn = await _conn()
    ib, notes = FakeIB(), FakeNotifier()
    ex = Executor(conn, _config_sltp(stop=0.5, target=1.0), ib, notes)
    ib.register_order_update(ex.on_order_update)  # wired exactly as main.py does
    await ex.process_signal(_signal("buy", 952, premium=2.0))  # entry fills 100 (0.15*100k/200)

    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}
    entry_qty = rows["buy"]["filled_qty"]
    assert entry_qty > 0

    tp_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['take_profit']['order_id']}"
    sl_ref = f"KENNY:{rows['stop_loss']['order_id']}"

    # Broker reports the take-profit leg filled, then (OCA) the stop cancelled.
    await ib.on_update(_update(tp_ref, ostore.FILLED, filled=entry_qty, avg=4.0))
    await ib.on_update(_update(sl_ref, ostore.CANCELLED))

    rows = {r["signal_type"]: r for r in await ostore.list_orders(conn)}
    assert rows["take_profit"]["status"] == ostore.FILLED
    assert rows["take_profit"]["filled_qty"] == entry_qty
    assert rows["stop_loss"]["status"] == ostore.CANCELLED
    # net position is flat (BUY filled - SELL filled == 0)
    assert await ostore.open_positions(conn, "KENNY") == []

    # The take-profit fill is notified and tagged to the entry order it protects.
    tp_updates = [(r, u) for r, u in notes.order_updates if r["signal_type"] == "take_profit"]
    assert tp_updates, "expected a take-profit order-update notification"

    assert u.status == ostore.FILLED
    assert r.get("parent_order_id") == rows["buy"]["order_id"]

class FakeIB:
    def __init__(self, *, net_liq=100_000, avail=100_000, cash=100_000,
                 mark_px=5.0, qualify_ok=True, status=ostore.FILLED):
        self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash = net_liq, avail, cash
        self.mark_px, self.qualify_ok, self.status = mark_px, qualify_ok, status
        self.placed: list[dict] = []
        self.cancels: list[str] = []
        self.modifies: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.on_update = None
        # Broker-live unfilled qty per ref for working_qty(); default 0 = "instantly
        # confirmed cancelled". A test can pin a ref high to simulate a cancel that never
        # lands. Records the order of consultation for ordering assertions.
        self.working: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.working_qty_calls: list[str] = []

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

async def _seed_standing_buy(conn, *, msg_id, requested_qty, filled_qty=0,
                             status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=1.5, ticker="TSLA",
                             strike=250.0):
    """A working entry BUY left non-FILLED (PENDING/SUBMITTED/PARTIAL) so it shows up in
    standing_buy_orders. A PARTIAL with filled_qty>0 also contributes to open_positions.
    Returns the order_id (so a test can assert the expected order_ref)."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(requested_qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status, filled_qty=filled_qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price if filled_qty else None)
    return oid

        self.on_update = None
        # Broker-live unfilled qty per ref for working_qty(); default 0 = "instantly
        # confirmed cancelled". A test can pin a ref high to simulate a cancel that never
        # lands. Records the order of consultation for ordering assertions.
        self.working: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.working_qty_calls: list[str] = []

    def account_snapshot(self):
        return AccountSnapshot(self.net_liq, self.avail, self.cash)

    def register_order_update(self, callback):
        self.on_update = callback

    async def qualify(self, option):
        if not self.qualify_ok:
            return None
        option.conId = 12345
        return option

    async def mark(self, contract):
        return self.mark_px

    async def place(self, contract, *, side, qty, order_ref, order_type,
                    limit_price=None, protective_exit=None, good_till=None):
        self.placed.append(dict(side=side, qty=qty, order_ref=order_ref,
                                order_type=order_type, limit_price=limit_price,
                                protective_exit=protective_exit, good_till=good_till))
        filled = qty if self.status in (ostore.FILLED, ostore.PARTIAL) else 0
        return PlaceResult(self.status, filled, limit_price or 1.5, 11, 22, None)

    async def cancel(self, order_ref):
        self.cancels.append(order_ref)

    async def modify(self, order_ref, *, qty):
        self.modifies.append((order_ref, qty))


class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))

def _fixed_interpret(result):
    async def _fn(**kwargs):
        return result
    return _fn

async def _seed_position(conn, *, action="buy", qty, price, ticker="TSLA", strike=250.0):
    sig = _signal(action, 1, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=ostore.FILLED, filled_qty=qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price)


async def _seed_standing_buy(conn, *, msg_id, requested_qty, filled_qty=0,
                             status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=1.5, ticker="TSLA",
                             strike=250.0):
    """A working entry BUY left non-FILLED (PENDING/SUBMITTED/PARTIAL) so it shows up in
    standing_buy_orders. A PARTIAL with filled_qty>0 also contributes to open_positions.
    Returns the order_id (so a test can assert the expected order_ref)."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ,
                                    requested_qty=int(requested_qty), limit_price=price)
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status, filled_qty=filled_qty,
                              avg_fill_price=price if filled_qty else None)
    return oid


async def _seed_leg(conn, *, signal_type, qty, ticker="NVDA", strike=900.0,
                    status=ostore.SUBMITTED, price=6.0, msg_id=1):
    """A resting protective SELL leg (stop_loss / take_profit) on a contract."""
    sig = _signal("buy", msg_id, ticker=ticker, strike=strike)
    occ = occ_symbol(ticker, sig.trade.expiry, sig.trade.option_type, strike)
    oid = await ostore.create_order(conn, signal=sig, occ_symbol=occ, requested_qty=int(qty),
                                    limit_price=price, signal_type=signal_type, side="SELL")
    await ostore.update_order(conn, oid, status=status)
    return oid

class FakeNotifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.placed, self.status, self.skips = [], [], []
        self.holds, self.errors = [], []
        self.order_updates = []
        self._next_mid = 7000

    async def notify_order_update(self, row, update):
        self.order_updates.append((row, update))

    async def notify_placed(self, signal, side, qty, limit_price, order_id):
        self.placed.append((signal, side, qty, order_id))

    async def notify_status(self, signal, result, order_id):
        self.status.append((signal, result, order_id))

    async def notify_skip(self, signal, reason):
        self.skips.append(reason)

    async def notify_hold(self, signal, confidence, reasoning):
        self._next_mid += 1
        self.holds.append((signal, confidence, self._next_mid))
        return (self._next_mid, 1)  # (posted message id, place answer id)

    async def notify_error(self, msg, reason):
        self.errors.append((msg, reason))
